title: Infestissumam
studio_context: Recorded in 2012 at Blackbird (Nashville), The Bridge (Glendale), Mayfire (Linköping) and Hufvudstaden (Söderköping).

drum_performances.name: The Nameless Ghoul on drums
drum_performances.why_it_matters: Year Zero's sixteenth hats broken for the backbeat, Secular Haze in 6/8 like a fairground organ waltz, Monstrance Clock's one bar of 5/4. The main credits name no drummer; the band is the Nameless Ghouls.

evidence.note: No drum credit to a named member in the main personnel; who played the studio drums is not stored.
